text: There's an app that rates your reel before you post it, and tells you exactly what to fix.
Not views after you post. Reasons, before.
It's called Creedom. It watches your whole reel, second by second, like a real viewer.
Then it scores it out of five, and flags the exact moments that need work: a weak hook, a claim with no proof, a moment that loses trust.
With the timestamp, and the fix.
So you fix it before anyone ever sees it.
Comment Check, and I'll send you the link.
